why_hard: The hardcoded total equals the correct sum today, so every value-based check passes and the arithmetic ties. Only a structural check (constant where the row expects a formula) or a sensitivity probe (perturb an input, observe the total fail to respond) can catch it.

seeded_errors.description: Total Opex is a typed constant, not a SUM. It matches the lines beneath it today and silently diverges the moment any input changes.
